Hi Claire / Ben — attaching the technical declaration and a simple dataflow spreadsheet. Key points summarised below (copying into the thread so procurement has a short statement they can use in the contract):

1) KMS / Key custody
- Hosted API: Customer data encryption at rest uses provider-managed CMKs by default. We support customer KMS integration (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) for dedicated keys. When a customer requests BYOK for Hosted, we offer a Managed Customer Key profile where the CMK is provisioned and controlled by the customer in their cloud account and access is restricted via IAM and explicit RBAC in Redwood.
- Dedicated & Private: Full BYOK supported; keys can be stored in customer-managed HSMs (FIPS 140-2/3) and referenced by Redwood via external KMS endpoints (no key material leaves customer HSM).

2) Cross-border processing / routing policy
- Default routing: Requests are routed to the customer's primary region. For Hosted customers without region restriction, routing defaults to region chosen during sign-up (US-EAST for NA, EU-WEST for EU, APAC-SG for APAC).
- Fallback behavior: If primary region capacity is unavailable, requests will be routed to the next compatible zone following policy: same continent -> nearest partner region -> general fallback (US) for non-geo-restricted tenants. We can enforce strict region-only routing under Dedicated or Private contracts (no cross-border fallback).

3) Dataflow mapping (attached dpflow-mapping.xlsx)
- Sheet 1 shows categories (personal identifiers, pseudonymised data, model-request tokens) and target runtime zones.

4) DPA & DPF annex notes
- We include a DPA annex that references our cross-border controls and the available safeguards (SCCs, standard contractual clauses alternatives where applicable). We will mark the annex to indicate: (a) Customer can opt into BYOK; (b) Region lock is available as a paid configuration for Hosted; (c) Audit log retention window differs by plan and can be extended in Dedicated.

Attachments (in this email):
- redwood_dpa_annex_v2.pdf (annotated) — summary language for procurement/legal
- kms-diagram.png — key flow visuals (customer HSM -> external KMS endpoint -> Redwood runtime)
- dpflow-mapping.xlsx — simple mapping table for Northpoint review

Claire, let me know if you want a redlined DPA annex or a one-page procurement-ready statement.

—Kimberly Park
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
